title: Luciferase Reporter Assay for NF-kB Activation
author: Opentrons

steps.title: Prepare PBS and load test articles
steps.instruction: Prepare washing PBS (50 µL per sample; 6.5 mL total for 96 samples) and dispense it into the first well of a NEST 1 Well Reservoir (195 mL capacity). Dilute each test article in DMEM to the desired concentrations, then pre‑load the diluted solutions into a Corning 96‑Well Plate (Flat, 360 µL capacity) adding 150 µL of each dilution per well.

substeps.instruction: Add 50 µL PBS to each well of the reservoir (total 6.5 mL for 96 wells).
Fill the first well of the NEST 1 Well Reservoir (195 mL) with the PBS solution.
Dilute test articles in DMEM to the required concentrations.
Dispense 150 µL of each diluted test article into the corresponding wells of a Corning 96‑Well Plate (Flat, 360 µL).

steps.title: Transfer supernatant to waste
steps.instruction: Remove the culture medium from the working plate by transferring the supernatant from each well of the WORKING PLATE to the designated waste container.

steps.title: Wash cells with PBS
steps.instruction: Add 50 µL of the prepared washing PBS to each well of the WORKING PLATE to wash the cells.

steps.title: Add treatment to cells
steps.instruction: Transfer 100 µL of each test article from the TREATMENT plate to the corresponding well of the WORKING PLATE (100 µL per well).
